reason: Twice, a production-truth governance PR completed or approached green while main advanced underneath it. Merging either stale-base PR would violate current production truth.
rootCause: Concurrent main advancement can invalidate the base identity after CI has started or completed.
failedApproach: Treat a previously green or nearly-green PR as current truth without rechecking its base against current main immediately before merge.
fix: Close the stale-base PR, replay the intended delta on current main, rerun protected gates, and merge only when the PR base still equals current main at merge time.
